author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Stick-figure runner (human_ref full_body): r4 head 8 above a vertical neck run, stiff arm extended back, other arm carrying a 45-degree American football with a seam, stance and trailing legs; the ball reads as a football, not an eye/egg, at 48 in both themes. HRECT_L gives the ball room.
omissions: Outlined silhouette limbs become single strokes; the ball is held in front rather than tucked inside the arm crook (no room for 8-unit clearance).
